items.title: 新增 EIP：MLOAD8 与 CALLDATALOAD8 操作码
items.note: （Helkomine）提交，Magicians 讨论 17:12：单次操作读取一个字节，相比 MLOAD 或 CALLDATALOAD 加移位，降低 gas 与字节码体积。
items.title_en: Add EIP: MLOAD8 and CALLDATALOAD8 Opcodes

keywords_en: BPO2 live with blob target and max raised to 14 and 21
blob prices spike after the increase
EIP-8051 defines the ML-DSA norm bound
the Dark Bio post-quantum crypto suite
summary_en: BPO2 went live, raising the blob target and max from 10 and 15 to 14 and 21; terencechain saw blob prices spike rather than drop, likely as some chain ramped usage after the increase. Helkomine submitted EIP-8120, opcodes that read a single byte from memory or calldata to save gas. yyhrnk defined the beta norm bound for the EIP-8051 ML-DSA verification precompile.
